name: Monthly register
prompt: Design a full-bleed 1440px wide (landscape 3:2) desktop screenshot of real polished software, phooey! finance, a finance dashboard for a solopreneur. This revision absolutely requires compact modern sans-serif typography everywhere (Geist or similar), a restrained 24px heading, tabular numbers, a graph-led screen with a real tool strip and data density. Light warm neutral background, rich deep green ink #173C35, muted burnt-orange expense series #BD522D, jade net series. Actual user chrome, no marketing, no eyebrows or ornamental labels, no fake growth badges, no bank logos. Use existing lowercase round bold "phooey!" wordmark. Operational navigation must include Overview, Transactions, Reports, Accounts, Invoicer and Settings. Use fictional figures: period income $48,600, expenses $16,240, net $32,360. Add transaction, reporting period, currency (USD), graph style selector and a graph/table view toggle. All controls that appear must make sense. Typography should look like a meticulously typeset contemporary web app at 100% zoom. Full app viewport; no outer frame. An ultra-compact 185px light neutral sidebar with active overview in muted sage. Desktop workspace arranged as a side-by-side explorer. Left two-thirds is a striking tall grouped monthly bar chart (green income paired with rust expenses, Jan-Nov) topped by a short row of three operational metrics and bar/line/table view options. The narrow right column is a dense monthly numeric register (Month / In / Out) with an active month and a small ranked spending-by-category chart below. The bottom of the main content starts a Recent transactions table. Clean well spaced type at data-dense scale. The two columns share an aligned header strip with date range and currency controls.
